name: fix_ts_csv_formula_injection
description: CSV export with no formula-injection guard -> neutralize =/+/-/@/tab/CR prefixes with a leading apostrophe; incomplete-fix broken only guards the '=' prefix
prompts: toCsvField(value) in csv.ts quotes/escapes commas, quotes, and newlines for CSV export, but does nothing about CSV/formula injection: a field value starting with =, +, -, or @ (or a leading tab/CR) becomes an executable formula when the exported file is opened in Excel or Google Sheets. Fix it: if the value starts with any of those characters, prefix it with a single leading apostrophe (') BEFORE the existing comma/quote/newline escaping - spreadsheet software treats a leading apostrophe as 'this is literal text', neutralizing the formula trigger while keeping the value's content intact and readable. Guard ALL of =, +, -, @, tab, and CR - not just '='. Existing comma/quote/newline escaping must keep working exactly as before for benign values.
check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build csv.ts test_csv.ts && node build/test_csv.js
